text: The expired-key composition test now reads buttons[0].buttonInfo["l10n-id"] rather than reading l10n-id directly from the wrapper. This is the test’s current notification metadata shape; it does not test a translated accessible name or the button click. Keep exact metadata access separate from visible control validation.
